beam.codebook_count_scope: Unique within each seed and arm; sums combine these within-seed counts and include the attributed bootstrap expansion.
beam.last_best_improvement_round_scope: Comparison rounds 1..12; zero means no improvement after the common bootstrap.
beam.rollout_scope: Descriptive unweighted mean over the 24 seeds; both arms use the inherited evaluation generator.

greedy.codebook_count_scope: Unique within each seed and arm; sums combine these within-seed counts and include the attributed bootstrap expansion.
greedy.last_best_improvement_round_scope: Comparison rounds 1..12; zero means no improvement after the common bootstrap.
greedy.rollout_scope: Descriptive unweighted mean over the 24 seeds; both arms use the inherited evaluation generator.

official_statistics.causal_controls: Width-three distinct-codebook beam retention with frozen parents per round versus one incumbent with three sequential greedy expansions; same shared bootstrap and fitting caps

comparisons.confirmation_policy: The official FSI result is reported intact. The LS16 study stays PILOT_ONLY because direct beam power and matched-sham calibration were unavailable before execution.
comparisons.scope_note: Independent representative clusters and symmetric paired-label null are declared assumptions; clustered bootstrap has weak small-G coverage. Floors above zero require conservative Hoeffding lower bounds. Bonferroni covers the stated preplanned family only. Reuse requires an untouched sealed confirmation readout.
comparisons.support_scope: Exact-real certificates repairing proven initial point violations on fresh seeds from the fixed synthetic perturbation generator
comparisons.target_population: Fresh independently seeded 15-percent perturbations of the fixed eight-GELU mod4 template under the locked LS16 search budget; exact-real certificates repairing proven initial point violations

official_statistics.interval_scope: Official per-arm Clopper-Pearson intervals are marginal 95-percent intervals under independent Bernoulli seed sampling; they do not jointly cover both arms at 95 percent.
official_statistics.matched_sham_source: No calibrated LS16 beam sham; historical preflight supplies the universal support bound 1
official_statistics.readout_selection_exposure: Fresh perturbation seeds remain sealed until source lock. The known 32 transition cases guide fitting and selection; they are not unseen tasks. Research design uses earlier LS studies.

physical_compute.timing_scope: Worker elapsed durations can overlap; their sum is neither process CPU time nor stage wall time. Manifest wall time includes initialization and search, and excludes exact audit and reporting.

posthoc_interpretation_check.scope: This ordering check was added after inspecting outcomes. It adds no test and does not establish necessity of any edge. Intermediate numerical crossings remain distinct from the exact terminal certificates.
